content.short: Airtm is a digital dollar wallet and peer-to-peer exchange that lets people in emerging markets hold and send USDC.
content.description: Airtm, founded in 2015 and based in Mexico City and San Francisco, runs a digital dollar wallet and peer-to-peer exchange for people across Latin America and other emerging markets. Users hold money as USDC, a dollar stablecoin, and add or withdraw funds through more than 500 local payment methods, which helps them protect savings from local currency devaluation. For businesses, Airtm handles mass payouts, payroll and marketplace disbursements, converting between local currencies and USDC. The Stellar Development Foundation has invested 15 million dollars to support its payouts.
